links.comparator_used: Original, unedited ASSH and BSSH website patient articles
links.outcome: Readability of patient-focused hand surgery articles across seven readability formulas
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 rewrites improved readability across all chosen formulas, reached a mean sixth-grade level on Flesch Kincaid Grade Level and SMOG, and increased the mean Flesch Reading Ease score. No numeric values given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: Accuracy was not measured; the authors caution that ChatGPT-4 prioritises sounding natural over truth, so information accuracy may be sacrificed for readability and each response needs surgeon evaluation.
links.quote: Chat Generative Pre-Trained Transformer version 4 was able to improve the readability across all chosen readability formulas and was successful in achieving a mean sixth-grade readability level in terms of the Flesch Kincaid Grade Level and Simple Measure of Gobbledygook calculations.
